title: Co-living
whyTempting: Housing is expensive; people are lonely.
whyItFails: Real estate costs. Leases are expensive. Churn. Residents move often. Community decays. Culture is hard to maintain.

attempts.outcome: US arm filed for bankruptcy and closed its US locations
attempts.notes: Quarters' US entity filed for Chapter 7 in January 2021, and its European portfolio was absorbed by Habyt
Common Living filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy and completely ceased operations in June 2024, leading to the liquidation of its assets.
WeWork's co-living venture in New York and near Washington DC.
